verses.text_urhobo: Ọke rẹ Aizik vwọ ghwọ re rẹ ẹro rọye vwo dje rọ gbe mrẹ orẹ-ẹ, o de se Isọ rẹ ọmọkpako rọye, ọ da ta kẹ, Mọmẹ, ọ da kpahe kẹ, Mẹvwẹ na.
verses.text_romanized: oke re aizik vwo ghwo re re ero roye vwo dje ro gbe mre ore e o de se iso re omokpako roye o da ta ke mome o da kpahe ke mevwe na

verses.text_urhobo: O da ta, Nighe, Me ghwore; Me riẹn ẹdẹ rẹ ughwu mẹ-ẹ.
verses.text_romanized: o da ta nighe me ghwore me rien ede re ughwu me e

verses.text_urhobo: Vwẹ enẹna, gba reyọ ekuakua wẹn, ekpo rẹ edada wẹn, kugbe umurhabọ wẹn, ru wo kpo aghwa, ra bẹre ibefi ru wo hwe eranvwe rhe vwe,
verses.text_romanized: vwe enena gba reyo ekuakua wen ekpo re edada wen kugbe umurhabo wen ru wo kpo aghwa ra bere ibefi ru wo hwe eranvwe rhe vwe

verses.text_urhobo: ru wo chere emu ọvwevwerhe kẹ vwẹ, emu rọ vwerhe ovwẹ, ru wo muo rhe vwe re Me re, rere Me nẹ ẹrhovwo kẹ wẹ mi ki ghwu.
verses.text_romanized: ru wo chere emu ovwevwerhe ke vwe emu ro vwerhe ovwe ru wo muo rhe vwe re me re rere me ne erhovwo ke we mi ki ghwu

verses.text_urhobo: Vwẹ ọke yena Rebeka ra kerhọ rẹ Aizik vwọ ta kẹ Isọ rẹ ọmọ rọye. Kọye ọke rẹ Isọ vwo kpo aghwa re hwe eranvwe rhe,
verses.text_romanized: vwe oke yena rebeka ra kerho re aizik vwo ta ke iso re omo roye koye oke re iso vwo kpo aghwa re hwe eranvwe rhe

verses.text_urhobo: Rebeka da ta kẹ ọmọ rọye Jekọp, Mi nyo umri rẹ ọsẹ wẹn rọ ta kẹ oniọvo wẹn Isọ nẹ,
verses.text_romanized: rebeka da ta ke omo roye jekop mi nyo umri re ose wen ro ta ke oniovo wen iso ne

verses.text_urhobo: Hwe eranvwe rhe vwe, rere wo vwo chere emu ọvwevwerhe, rere Me riọ, re Me nẹ ẹrhovwo kẹ wẹ vwẹ irharo rẹ Ọrovwohwo tavwe mi ki ghwu.
verses.text_romanized: hwe eranvwe rhe vwe rere wo vwo chere emu ovwevwerhe rere me rio re me ne erhovwo ke we vwe irharo re orovwohwo tavwe mi ki ghwu

verses.text_urhobo: Fiki rẹ ọtiọye na ọmọ mẹ, gbe nyo ota na re Me ta kẹ wẹ na.
verses.text_romanized: fiki re otioye na omo me gbe nyo ota na re me ta ke we na

verses.text_urhobo: Kpo obo uchuru na, re wo mu emọ rẹ ẹkpro ivẹ rhe, rere mi vwo chere emu ọvwevwerhe kẹ ọsẹ wẹn, ọtiẹ emu rọ vwerhọ;
verses.text_romanized: kpo obo uchuru na re wo mu emo re ekpro ive rhe rere mi vwo chere emu ovwevwerhe ke ose wen otie emu ro vwerho

verses.text_urhobo: ku wo muo rhe ọsẹ wẹn rọ re, rere ọ nẹ ẹrhovwo kẹ wẹ ro ki ghwu.
verses.text_romanized: ku wo muo rhe ose wen ro re rere o ne erhovwo ke we ro ki ghwu

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo Jekọp da ta kẹ Rebeka rẹ oni rọye, Nighe, oniọvo mẹ Isọ ọ pha ẹtuẹnto, ye Me pha bọbọbọ.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo jekop da ta ke rebeka re oni roye nighe oniovo me iso o pha etuento ye me pha bobobo

verses.text_urhobo: Ọkeọvo ọsẹ mẹ cha vwẹ obọ te vwe, ke Me họhọ ohwo rọ vwọ jehwẹ, ke Me vwo eka kẹ oma mẹ ọ rha dia ẹrhovwo-o.
verses.text_romanized: okeovo ose me cha vwe obo te vwe ke me hoho ohwo ro vwo jehwe ke me vwo eka ke oma me o rha dia erhovwo o

verses.text_urhobo: Oni rọye da ta kẹ, Jẹn eka ra harhe owẹ dia uyovwi mẹ, ọmọ mẹ, takpi nyo ota mẹ ru wọ yanran, re mu eranvwe na rhe vwe.
verses.text_romanized: oni roye da ta ke jen eka ra harhe owe dia uyovwi me omo me takpi nyo ota me ru wo yanran re mu eranvwe na rhe vwe

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin ọ da yanran re mu ayen rhe oni rọye, oni rọye de chere emu ọvwevwerhe, ọtiẹ emu rọ vwerhọ.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin o da yanran re mu ayen rhe oni roye oni roye de chere emu ovwevwerhe otie emu ro vwerho

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Rebeka da reyọ ewu rẹ Isọ rẹ ọmọkpako rọye na, rọ evun rẹ uwevwi jovwo, o de kuo phihọ Jekọp rẹ omotete na,
verses.text_romanized: etiyin rebeka da reyo ewu re iso re omokpako roye na ro evun re uwevwi jovwo o de kuo phiho jekop re omotete na

verses.text_urhobo: ọ da reyọ, ophiẹn rẹ ẹmẹvwe na vwọ phare abọ vẹ edigbo ohọre rọye;
verses.text_romanized: o da reyo ophien re emevwe na vwo phare abo ve edigbo ohore roye

verses.text_urhobo: o de mu emu ọvwevwerhe na kugbe ikara rọ nabọ kaka na, vwọ kẹ ọmọ rọye Jekọp.
verses.text_romanized: o de mu emu ovwevwerhe na kugbe ikara ro nabo kaka na vwo ke omo roye jekop

verses.text_urhobo: O de mu emu na rhe ọsẹ rọye, ọ da ta, Baba; o de nyo kẹ nẹ, Mẹvwẹ na, wẹ ono vwo mọmẹ?
verses.text_romanized: o de mu emu na rhe ose roye o da ta baba o de nyo ke ne mevwe na we ono vwo mome

verses.text_urhobo: Jekọp da ta kẹ ọsẹ rọye, Mẹvwẹ Isọ rẹ ọmọkpako wẹn. Mi ruru kirobo re wọ ta kẹ vwẹ nure, gbe vrẹn tidia re wọ re eranvwe mẹ, rere wọ nẹ ẹrhovwo kẹ vwẹ.
verses.text_romanized: jekop da ta ke ose roye mevwe iso re omokpako wen mi ruru kirobo re wo ta ke vwe nure gbe vren tidia re wo re eranvwe me rere wo ne erhovwo ke vwe

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo, Aizik da ta kẹ ọmọ rọye, Mavọ wọ ghwa fobọ mrẹ eranvwe na phẹrẹkpẹ ọtiọye, ọmọ Me? Ọ da kpahe, Kidie Ọrovwohwo rẹ Ọghẹnẹ wẹn vwe rọ kẹ vwẹ. Aizik da ta ke Jekọp,
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo aizik da ta ke omo roye mavo wo ghwa fobo mre eranvwe na pherekpe otioye omo me o da kpahe kidie orovwohwo re oghene wen vwe ro ke vwe aizik da ta ke jekop

verses.text_urhobo: Bi te vwe oma te, rere Me vwẹ obọ te we, ọmọ mẹ, rere mi vughe uwe se owẹ Isọ eyẹ ohwo ọfa.
verses.text_romanized: bi te vwe oma te rere me vwe obo te we omo me rere mi vughe uwe se owe iso eye ohwo ofa

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Jekọp de si kẹrẹ Aizik rẹ ọsẹ rọye, ọ da vwẹ obọ gbe ọ da ta, Urhuru na urhuru ri Jekọp, ẹkẹvuọvo abọ na kiri abọ rẹ Isọ.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin jekop de si kere aizik re ose roye o da vwe obo gbe o da ta urhuru na urhuru ri jekop ekevuovo abo na kiri abo re iso

verses.text_urhobo: O gbi se vughe-e, kidie abọ rọye pha ẹtuẹnto kiri abọ rẹ oniọvo rọye Isọ, Etiyin ọ da nẹ ẹrhovwo kẹ.
verses.text_romanized: o gbi se vughe e kidie abo roye pha etuento kiri abo re oniovo roye iso etiyin o da ne erhovwo ke

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da ta kẹ, Wẹ ghine ọmọ mẹ Isọ? Ọ da kpahe, Mẹvwẹ ọye.
verses.text_romanized: o da ta ke we ghine omo me iso o da kpahe mevwe oye

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin ọ da ta, Gbe muo rhe vwe, rere Me re eranvwe rẹ ọmọ mẹ re Me nẹ ẹrhovwo kẹ wẹ, o de mu emu na rhe, ọ da re; ọ da vwẹ udi kẹ, ọ da da.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin o da ta gbe muo rhe vwe rere me re eranvwe re omo me re me ne erhovwo ke we o de mu emu na rhe o da re o da vwe udi ke o da da

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin ọsẹ rọye Aizik da ta kẹ, Gbe si kẹrẹ ovwẹ re wọ fiọnfiọn ovwẹ, ọmọ mẹ.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin ose roye aizik da ta ke gbe si kere ovwe re wo fionfion ovwe omo me

verses.text_urhobo: O de si kẹrẹ ọ da fiọnfiọn, ọ da vwẹ ewu rọye gbọrhe ọ da nẹ ẹrhovwo kẹ, ọ da ta, No, ọnrhẹn rẹ ọmọ mẹ kiri ọnrhe rẹ okogbe rẹ Ọrovwohwo bruphihọ kẹ,
verses.text_romanized: o de si kere o da fionfion o da vwe ewu roye gborhe o da ne erhovwo ke o da ta no onrhen re omo me kiri onrhe re okogbe re orovwohwo bruphiho ke

verses.text_urhobo: Ọghẹnẹ kẹ wẹ evwru rẹ obo odjuvwu, kugbe ivwri rẹ otọ na, vẹ ọka buebu kugbe udi.
verses.text_romanized: oghene ke we evwru re obo odjuvwu kugbe ivwri re oto na ve oka buebu kugbe udi

verses.text_urhobo: Jẹn ihwo ga wẹ, irere ki shiguẹ kẹ wẹ. Ku wọ dia olori vwẹ enu rẹ iniọvo wẹn Jẹn emọ rẹ oni wẹn vwẹ uyovwi te otọ kẹ wẹ. Eka kẹ ohwo rọ harha owẹ Ẹrhovwo kẹ ohwo rọ nẹ ẹrhovwo kẹ wẹ.
verses.text_romanized: jen ihwo ga we irere ki shigue ke we ku wo dia olori vwe enu re iniovo wen jen emo re oni wen vwe uyovwi te oto ke we eka ke ohwo ro harha owe erhovwo ke ohwo ro ne erhovwo ke we

verses.text_urhobo: Rẹ Aizik ghwa vwọ nẹ ẹrhovwo kẹ Jekọp nu, ri Jekọp ghwa vwọ ro otafe nẹ obaro rẹ ọsẹ rọye nu, Isọ rẹ oniọvo rọye na de ghwe nẹ ibefi rhe.
verses.text_romanized: re aizik ghwa vwo ne erhovwo ke jekop nu ri jekop ghwa vwo ro otafe ne obaro re ose roye nu iso re oniovo roye na de ghwe ne ibefi rhe

verses.text_urhobo: O de ji chere emu ọvwevwerhe, o de muo rhe ọsẹ rọye, Ọ da ta kẹ ọsẹ rọye, Gbe ji Baba vrẹn, re ọ re eranvwe rẹ ọmọ rọye, re wọ nẹ ẹrhovwo kẹ vwẹ.
verses.text_romanized: o de ji chere emu ovwevwerhe o de muo rhe ose roye o da ta ke ose roye gbe ji baba vren re o re eranvwe re omo roye re wo ne erhovwo ke vwe

verses.text_urhobo: Ọsẹ rọye Aizik da ta kẹ, Wẹ ono vwo? Ọ da kpahe, Mẹvwẹ ọmọ wẹn, ọmọkpako wẹn Isọ.
verses.text_romanized: ose roye aizik da ta ke we ono vwo o da kpahe mevwe omo wen omokpako wen iso

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Aizik kọ phariẹ guegue, ọ da ta, Kono ri hwe eranvwe ro de muo rhe vwe, Me rerọ ejobi nu tavwe wọ ke rhe, Me je vwẹ ẹrhovwo kẹ nureọ? uyota ke bruphihọ kẹ.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin aizik ko pharie guegue o da ta kono ri hwe eranvwe ro de muo rhe vwe me rero ejobi nu tavwe wo ke rhe me je vwe erhovwo ke nureo uyota ke bruphiho ke

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke rẹ Isọ vwo nyo ota rẹ ọsẹ rọye, o de shugo rẹ oviẹ ọ da viẹ oviẹ rọ yara, ọ da ta kẹ ọsẹ rọye, Nẹ ẹrhovwo kẹ vwẹ, ji te omẹvwẹ rhe, E ọsẹ mẹ;
verses.text_romanized: oke re iso vwo nyo ota re ose roye o de shugo re ovie o da vie ovie ro yara o da ta ke ose roye ne erhovwo ke vwe ji te omevwe rhe e ose me

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo ọ da ta kẹ, Oniọvo wẹn ọ vwẹ ophiẹvwe rhe, ọ da reyọ ẹrhovwo wẹn mie we.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo o da ta ke oniovo wen o vwe ophievwe rhe o da reyo erhovwo wen mie we

verses.text_urhobo: Isọ da ta, Oteri re vwo se Jekọp? Kidie Etiyin asiava ọ vwẹ ona ru vwe re. O mie vwe ọkpako mẹ, gbe rhe nighe ọ rha je reyọ ẹrhovwo Me re. O da rhoma ta kẹ, Wo rhe ji ẹmẹ ẹrhovwo kẹ vwẹ-ẹ?
verses.text_romanized: iso da ta oteri re vwo se jekop kidie etiyin asiava o vwe ona ru vwe re o mie vwe okpako me gbe rhe nighe o rha je reyo erhovwo me re o da rhoma ta ke wo rhe ji eme erhovwo ke vwe e

verses.text_urhobo: Aizik da ta kẹ Isọ, Nighe, mi vwi ro ru olori vwẹ enu wẹn nure, Me je vwẹ iniọvo wẹn ejobi kẹ ne dia idibo kẹ nure, te ọka te udi Me vwọ ba kẹ. Kidie ọfa mi ji ru kẹ wẹ, ọmọ mẹ?
verses.text_romanized: aizik da ta ke iso nighe mi vwi ro ru olori vwe enu wen nure me je vwe iniovo wen ejobi ke ne dia idibo ke nure te oka te udi me vwo ba ke kidie ofa mi ji ru ke we omo me

verses.text_urhobo: Isọ da ta kẹ ọsẹ rọye, Kaka ẹmẹ ẹrhovwo ọvo gbe herọ, ọsẹ mẹ? Nẹ ẹrhovwo kẹ vwẹ, ji te omẹvwẹ rhe, E ọsẹ mẹ. Isọ de kuenu rẹ oviẹ.
verses.text_romanized: iso da ta ke ose roye kaka eme erhovwo ovo gbe hero ose me ne erhovwo ke vwe ji te omevwe rhe e ose me iso de kuenu re ovie

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Aizik rẹ ọsẹ rọye da kpahe kẹ: Nighe, asan ro tephe kẹ ivwri rẹ otọ na ọye cha dia ẹdia wẹn, ro ji tephe kẹ evwru rẹ odjuvwu.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin aizik re ose roye da kpahe ke nighe asan ro tephe ke ivwri re oto na oye cha dia edia wen ro ji tephe ke evwru re odjuvwu

verses.text_urhobo: Odan wẹ wọ vwọ riemu, ku wọ ga oniọvo wẹn; ẹkẹvuọvo wọ da pharhe vabọ ku wo vwirhi ọghrọrọ nẹ ohọre wẹn.
verses.text_romanized: odan we wo vwo riemu ku wo ga oniovo wen ekevuovo wo da pharhe vabo ku wo vwirhi oghroro ne ohore wen

verses.text_urhobo: Kẹ ọke nana yanran oma ri Jekọp ko tuẹ Isọ fiki rẹ ẹrhovwo rẹ ọsẹ rọye nẹ kẹ, Isọ da ta kẹ omoma rọye, Ẹdẹ rẹ ughwu ri Baba kẹrire, ke Me teye oniọvo mẹ na Jekọp hwe.
verses.text_romanized: ke oke nana yanran oma ri jekop ko tue iso fiki re erhovwo re ose roye ne ke iso da ta ke omoma roye ede re ughwu ri baba kerire ke me teye oniovo me na jekop hwe

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo eta rẹ Isọ na rẹ ọmọkpako rọye na e de rhi gbe ayen kẹ Rebeka; o de ji ohwo re se Jekọp rẹ omotete rọye na, ọ da vuẹ nẹ, Nighe, Isọ rẹ oniọvo wẹn ọ rọ jẹn iroro ro vwo hwe we, ọke o di nẹ na.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo eta re iso na re omokpako roye na e de rhi gbe ayen ke rebeka o de ji ohwo re se jekop re omotete roye na o da vue ne nighe iso re oniovo wen o ro jen iroro ro vwo hwe we oke o di ne na

verses.text_urhobo: Wẹ ọmọ mẹ, kerhọ mẹ, vrẹn, wọ djẹ bru Laban rẹ oniọvo mẹ vwi Haran,
verses.text_romanized: we omo me kerho me vren wo dje bru laban re oniovo me vwi haran

verses.text_urhobo: re wọ vọye dia oboyi emerha, bẹsiẹ rẹ ophun rẹ oniọvo wẹn vwo fue;
verses.text_romanized: re wo voye dia oboyi emerha besie re ophun re oniovo wen vwo fue

verses.text_urhobo: bẹsiẹ rẹ ophun rẹ oniọvo wẹn vwo fue, rẹ obo ri wo ruro vwọ choẹro, ki mi ji ohwo ra reyọ owẹ nẹ oboyi rhe. Mavọ emọ rẹ ọmiọvwọ ivẹ ghwẹ ukpẹdọke?
verses.text_romanized: besie re ophun re oniovo wen vwo fue re obo ri wo ruro vwo choero ki mi ji ohwo ra reyo owe ne oboyi rhe mavo emo re omiovwo ive ghwe ukpedoke

verses.text_urhobo: Rebeka da ta kẹ Aizik, Ofu rẹ akpọ mẹ dje vwe vwi fiki rẹ eya ri Hit. Ọ da dianẹ Jekọp rọvwọ aye ri Hit tiọnana, usun rẹ eya rẹ otọ na, ki didi akpọ mi yeri?
verses.text_romanized: rebeka da ta ke aizik ofu re akpo me dje vwe vwi fiki re eya ri hit o da diane jekop rovwo aye ri hit tionana usun re eya re oto na ki didi akpo mi yeri
